annotations.title: Nurse aide (CNA) registry checks and onboarding deadlines for a nursing home hire, with official registry pages (signed)

description: Nurse aide (CNA) onboarding for a Medicare/Medicaid nursing home: send the work state, other states the aide worked or was listed in, where the aide stands (listed, in_training, completed_not_listed) and dates. Get the federal steps (registry verification before the first shift, every other state's registry, no abuse/neglect findings, 4-month limit, 24-month retraining, 12-month review, 12 hours in-service, OIG exclusion check) with due dates, rule citations (42 CFR 483.35(d), 483.12(a)(3), 483.156, 483.95(g)), the official registry lookup page per confirmed state (CA, FL, MI, MN, NY, OH, PA, TX), what to keep in the file and a signed record. check_sources true also asks the eCFR for later amendments and whether each named registry page answers (20 source checks an hour per caller). Does not look anyone up; accepts no names. Free: 120 calls an hour per caller. The tool stores nothing. No model.

check_sources.description: Also read the eCFR version history of the four rules and ask each named registry page whether it answers.

last_paid_nursing_work.description: Last day the aide was paid for nursing or nursing-related services, anywhere (YYYY-MM-DD). Needed for the 24-month check.

last_performance_review.description: For an aide already employed: date of the last performance review (YYYY-MM-DD).

other_states.description: Other states where the aide worked or was listed (up to 10).

program_completed_on.description: Date of the aide's most recent completed training and competency evaluation program or competency evaluation (YYYY-MM-DD).

start_date.description: First day the aide works at the facility (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

status.description: listed = on a State registry (default); in_training = full-time employee in a State-approved training and competency evaluation program; completed_not_listed = recently completed an approved program, not yet on the registry.

work_state.description: Two-letter code of the state where the aide will work, e.g. TX.
